sources.title: Immigration and visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of Panama in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Panama's live official Embassy consular page publishes its named no-visa visitor-country list and expressly includes Cambodia.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa Required: IF you are from any of the following countries ... Cambodia

policies.title: Cambodian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's current Embassy visitor schedule expressly includes Cambodia in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: The Embassy page states a maximum stay of three months for the named no-visa-required cohort.
This covers ordinary Cambodian passports and visitor travel only; passport validity, onward travel, funds, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
